snapshot.query_class: COUNT / COUNT DISTINCT / information_schema only; no ST_*; no table dump

queries.name: information_schema.tables
queries.sql: BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('tx_city_boundary','tx_county_boundary','tx_utility_territory_staging') ORDER BY table_name; COMMIT;

queries.name: information_schema.columns
queries.sql: BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SELECT table_name, column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('tx_city_boundary','tx_county_boundary','tx_utility_territory_staging') AND column_name IN ('geo_id','service_kind','source','source_key') ORDER BY table_name, column_name; COMMIT;

queries.name: tx_city_boundary_counts
queries.sql: BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT geo_id)::bigint AS distinct_geo_id FROM tx_city_boundary; COMMIT;

queries.name: tx_county_boundary_counts
queries.sql: BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS row_count FROM tx_county_boundary; COMMIT;

queries.name: tx_utility_territory_staging_counts
queries.sql: BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT source_key)::bigint AS distinct_source_key FROM tx_utility_territory_staging; COMMIT;

queries.name: tx_utility_territory_staging_by_service_kind
queries.sql: BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SELECT service_kind, COUNT(*)::bigint AS n FROM tx_utility_territory_staging GROUP BY service_kind ORDER BY service_kind; COMMIT;

queries.name: tx_utility_territory_staging_by_source_key
queries.sql: BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SELECT source_key, service_kind, COUNT(*)::bigint AS n FROM tx_utility_territory_staging GROUP BY source_key, service_kind ORDER BY source_key; COMMIT;
